collection.title: Cadillac BLS 2005 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Cadillac BLS 2005 to 2009 Onwards model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
